title.id: UU No. 13 Tahun 2016 tentang Paten sebagaimana diubah terakhir dengan UU No. 65 Tahun 2024
title.en: Law No. 13 of 2016 on Patents as last amended by Law No. 65 of 2024

legal_basis: UU No. 65 Tahun 2024 tentang Perubahan Ketiga atas UU No. 13 Tahun 2016 tentang Paten

verification.note: Compiled from practitioner commentary (Rouse, Tilleke & Gibbins, Am Badar, Swanapada). One published translation describes a 12-month request-based grace period instead of an automatic 6-month period. The Working Statement deadline is reported as the end of each calendar year; the implementing regulation had not been issued. Confirm against the official text with Indonesian counsel.

working_statement.citation: UU 65/2024 - pernyataan pelaksanaan Paten (SRS merujuk Pasal 20A; verifikasi nomor pasal)
working_statement.note: Reported as due by the end of each year. The SRS describes it as due with the annuity cycle; switch mode to WITH_ANNUITY if counsel confirms that reading. Consequences of non-submission and the form of the statement await an implementing regulation.
